scenario.goal_zh: 向工作人员描述抢包经过并请其联系警方

context_zh: 乘客在车站服务台报告刚刚亲眼看到的抢包事件，请工作人员联系警方。
author: author-phase04-c

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: I saw a man steal my bag from the seat next to me. He ran out of the station.

sentences.speaker: Desk Officer May
sentences.text: Can you describe him and tell me which exit he used?

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: The thief had a yellow jacket and went through the doors by the cafe.

sentences.speaker: Desk Officer May
sentences.text: Did you notice any writing on the jacket?

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: Unfortunately, no. It happened so quickly.

sentences.speaker: Desk Officer May
sentences.text: Stay here with me. I'll contact the police and pass on the description.

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: Thank you. I can show you exactly where I was sitting.
